  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/421
  
  Details:
  Governor-side work on the transcript/PAT exposure incident:
  
  - Diagnosed scope: 8 distinct full-length fine-grained GitHub PATs (93-char) exposed in local session logs across 43 files; confirmed all fine-grained tokens were mis-covered by the transcript redactor.
  - Directed and approved the remediation: flip truesight_autopilot_transcript repo to private (executed + containment verified: anon 404 / visibility=private), approve the github_pat_ redaction rule (PR #421, merged + verified live), authorize crontab token removal, and authorize the session-log / syslog / journald scrub.
  - Granted GITHUB_TRANSCRIPT_PAT access to the private repo to restore publishing.
  - Made the final risk-acceptance call: accept residual PATs in local-only session logs, keep logs non-public, park token rotation.
  
  Co-authored with Sophia Truesight (autopilot contribution recorded separately).
